title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E6 — The Wrong Crowd
A motorcycle gang hijacks a Foundation truck containing computers and forces a young computer whiz to break into a local bank.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E24 — Trouble Brewing
A saboteur attempts to put two sisters (Suzanne Barnes, Claudia Christian) out of the soda business.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E25 — Incident at Crystal Lake
During a mountain holiday, the team is caught between robbers and the pursuing Army; guests Ken Swofford, Kristen Meadows.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E1 — Judgment Day
A judge hires the team to free his daughter, held prisoner in Italy by mobsters seeking to ensure the outcome of a trial.
